newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-DUMITRESCU SET TO JOIN AMERICA CUIDAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DUMITRESCU SET TO JOIN AMERICA CUIDAD.

text.p: Romanian soccer international Ilie Dumitrescu is set to join Mexican side America Cuidad after a disappointing spell with West Ham, the London club said on Monday.
West Ham's managing director Peter Storrie said details of the transfer still had to be completed.
"In principle we have an agreement for the sale of Ilie Dumitrescu, subject to a lot of things," Storrie said.
"He has also got to go over to Mexico and have a medical next week, so all being well I would anticipate the move could be completed by early 1997 but certainly not before Christmas."
Dumitrescu, who shone during the 1994 World Cup, joined English premier league side West Ham in March for 1.5 million pounds ($2.5 million).

But he played just three times for them in the closing months of last season, because of injury, and has been called on to play only seven times this season, including four appearances as a substitute.
